decision_log.decision: Binary classification: delayed = arrives ≥15 min late
decision_log.why: Decision is yes/no; BTS definition; delay minutes skewed (skew 3.36). Regression on minutes rejected.
decision_log.result: 327,346 labelled flights, 0.245 delayed.

decision_log.decision: Predict at 05:00 on day D; post-departure columns banned; history ends on D-1
decision_log.why: Early enough to act; about 3% of the previous day's flights land after midnight, so “end of previous day” is not exact.
decision_log.result: Leakage tests pass (2 passed in 7.08s); no post-departure column is a feature.

decision_log.decision: Cancelled/diverted flights unlabelled but kept on the schedule
decision_log.why: Label undefined; inventing one would fabricate data. They still occupy the schedule.
decision_log.result: 8,255 cancelled + 1,175 diverted excluded from training and scoring, counted in congestion features.

decision_log.decision: Metric fixed before modelling: PR AUC (+ ROC AUC, Brier, ECE, lift)
decision_log.why: Accuracy rewards “always on time”.
decision_log.result: “Always on time” scores 0.863 accuracy in September with zero recall; random scores PR AUC ≈ base rate.

decision_log.decision: Chronological split: warm-up Jan 1–14, train to Aug, valid Sep, calib Oct, test Nov–Dec (once)
decision_log.why: Same-day flights share weather; a random split leaks it.
decision_log.result: Shares 65.2/8.6/9.1/17.1%. Monthly delay rate ranges 0.137 (Sep) to 0.336 (Dec): a base-rate shift that later drives the calibration and threshold results.

decision_log.decision: Confidence intervals by day-block bootstrap
decision_log.why: Flights on one day are not independent.
decision_log.result: Test CIs are about ±0.05 wide (LR [0.351, 0.459]), which is what makes the LR/boosting gap non-significant.

decision_log.decision: EDA and every preprocessing statistic on training rows only
decision_log.why: Looking at valid/test while deciding is peeking.
decision_log.result: Pipelines fitted on train; imputer median of plane age (11.0) is the training median.

decision_log.decision: Impute aircraft fields (median + missing indicator); do not delete rows
decision_log.why: 17.47% missing, concentrated in MQ (95.1%) and AA (69.5%): systematic. Deleting would bias two airlines.
decision_log.result: Indicator columns keep the “unknown aircraft” signal; no rows lost.

decision_log.decision: Keep delay outliers
decision_log.why: 9.1% of flights are IQR outliers, but they are real delays and the yes/no label ignores size.
decision_log.result: No rows removed.

decision_log.decision: Check duplicates
decision_log.why: Worksheet checklist item 4.
decision_log.result: 0 full and 0 key duplicates: nothing to remove.

decision_log.decision: History windows chosen from ACF/PACF of the daily delay rate
decision_log.why: ACF lag 1 = 0.343, PACF lag 2 = -0.109, ACF lag 7 = 0.008 ⇒ 1-day window + day-of-week features; 7/28-day windows only for small groups.
decision_log.result: In notebook 03 the history group raised September PR AUC from 0.209 to 0.261.

decision_log.decision: No SMOTE / re-sampling
decision_log.why: Imbalance is moderate (0.268 delayed); re-sampling distorts probabilities.
decision_log.result: LR's raw test probabilities were already well calibrated (ECE 0.029).

decision_log.decision: Standard (z-score) scaler for the linear model
decision_log.why: Compared with a robust scaler.
decision_log.result: September PR AUC 0.1974 vs 0.1978: a tie, standard kept.

decision_log.decision: One-hot for linear models, ordinal codes for trees, native categoricals in XGBoost
decision_log.why: Integer codes imply a fake order to a linear model; trees only ask “code ≤ k?”.
decision_log.result: LR validation matrix: 120 columns.

decision_log.decision: Five feature groups, 41 numeric + 3 categorical
decision_log.why: Each group motivated by an EDA finding.
decision_log.result: LR with all five groups is best on both months (Sep 0.261, Oct 0.306). History adds +0.052 in Sep but only +0.002 in Oct.

decision_log.decision: Shrink history rates towards the overall rate (α = 10)
decision_log.why: A flight number seen 3 times gives an extreme, noisy rate.
decision_log.result: Small groups pulled to the mean; log-volume features say how much evidence a rate rests on.

decision_log.decision: No month or day-of-year feature
decision_log.why: Test months never appear in training, so month would act as a date ID.
decision_log.result: Seasonality enters only through history features (see drift, notebook 05).

decision_log.decision: Keep all features unless a method beats them on both September and October
decision_log.why: Filter (MI), VIF pruning, SFS (from scratch), L1, PCA tried.
decision_log.result: None passed. SFS: Sep 0.279 > 0.261 but Oct 0.281 < 0.306: it over-fitted the month it was selected on.

decision_log.decision: Report VIF but keep collinear features
decision_log.why: 13 features have VIF > 10; collinearity hurts interpretation, not prediction.
decision_log.result: Pruning 7 features lowered both months (0.256 / 0.302).

decision_log.decision: Baselines before any learned model
decision_log.why: Phase 7: a complex model must beat a simple rule.
decision_log.result: Sep / Oct PR AUC: majority 0.137 / 0.176; flight's 28-day rate 0.190 / 0.269; scheduled hour 0.188 / 0.229.

decision_log.decision: Logistic regression from scratch (batch, mini-batch, SGD), checked against scikit-learn
decision_log.why: Course training loop; log loss = Bernoulli MLE.
decision_log.result: Batch GD train log loss 0.5279 vs scikit-learn 0.5278; mini-batch 0.5282 in 5 epochs.

decision_log.decision: Learning-rate sweep for batch GD
decision_log.why: Show slow vs divergent steps.
decision_log.result: lr 0.01 → 0.6195 after 100 epochs (slow); 0.5 → 0.5282 (best); 8 → 2.3942 (diverged).

decision_log.decision: Choose L2 strength C on September only
decision_log.why: October and test must not choose settings.
decision_log.result: C = 0.001 (Sep 0.2655); scores barely move with C, so LR is bias-limited, not variance-limited.

decision_log.decision: Decision-tree depth sweep
decision_log.why: Show over-fitting.
decision_log.result: Unlimited depth: train 1.000, Sep 0.140; best Sep at depth 2 (0.180).

decision_log.decision: Compare families on rolling Jul/Aug/Sep with fixed configurations
decision_log.why: September alone is unusually calm; fixed settings avoid using future months.
decision_log.result: Mean PR AUC: LR 0.408 > random forest 0.386 > untuned XGBoost 0.366 > tree 0.328. LR is the model to beat; boosting goes on to tuning.

decision_log.decision: Gradient boosting from scratch, checked against scikit-learn
decision_log.why: Prove the theory (trees fitted to r = y - p, Newton leaf values).
decision_log.result: September log loss 0.4165 and PR AUC 0.208, identical to scikit-learn.

decision_log.decision: Honest early stopping: stop on month m-1, refit, score m
decision_log.why: Early-stopping on the scored month lets the stopping rule see the answers.
decision_log.result: Same configuration: optimistic mean 0.402 vs honest 0.382 (+0.020 inflation avoided).

decision_log.decision: Random search, 8 of 288 XGBoost configurations, honest rolling score
decision_log.why: Tuned boosting is the fair test of the project's model.
decision_log.result: Best: lr 0.03, depth 3, min child weight 50, subsample 0.7, colsample 0.5, λ 1.0 → 0.386. All 8 lie in 0.376–0.386, below LR (0.409).

decision_log.decision: Hybrid: XGBoost starts from LR's logit (base_margin) and learns corrections
decision_log.why: Zero trees = plain LR, so it should never be much worse.
decision_log.result: Rolling mean 0.406 (LR 0.409, boosting 0.386); trees per fold [16, 1219, 15].

decision_log.decision: Final tree count = median of the fold counts
decision_log.why: One calm month would stop far too early.
decision_log.result: Boosting folds [40, 110, 13] → 40 trees; hybrid → 16; September alone would pick 1.

decision_log.decision: Refit on Jan 15–Sep 30; Platt-calibrate on October
decision_log.why: Use the most recent month; calibrate on a month no model has seen.
decision_log.result: Boosting ECE 0.034 → 0.023 (better); LR 0.029 → 0.035 and hybrid 0.028 → 0.032 (worse: already calibrated, then October's lower base rate pulled them).

decision_log.decision: Test set (Nov–Dec) scored once, all models together
decision_log.why: Golden barrier.
decision_log.result: PR AUC: hybrid 0.403, LR 0.403, boosting 0.390, rule 0.369, majority 0.258. Intervals overlap: no winner among learned models.

decision_log.decision: Flag policy: calibrated p ≥ 0.5 instead of the October score threshold
decision_log.why: Delay rate rose from 0.176 (Oct) to 0.258 (test).
decision_log.result: October threshold: precision 0.538–0.547, recall 0.053–0.056, 25–26 flagged per 1000. Calibrated rule: precision 0.517–0.529, recall 0.085–0.097, 42–49 flagged, about 2× a random list.

decision_log.decision: Importance and ablation on October, never on test
decision_log.why: Analysis must not shape the reported score.
decision_log.result: Permutation: sched_hour 0.01726, h_flight_28d_rate 0.01424. Ablation: peak 0.303 with schedule+calendar+aircraft; + congestion 0.291; + history 0.264.

decision_log.decision: Error analysis by month and airport (lift)
decision_log.why: Where does each model fail?
decision_log.result: Boosting is weakest in November (lift 1.38 vs LR 1.58) and at JFK (1.44 vs 1.54); December is hard for all (about 1.35).
